description: Behavioural checks for the TI-84 Evo scripter skill. Each case states a prompt, what the agent must do, and what would count as a failure.

cases.prompt: Make me a program called TIPCALC for my TI-84 Evo that asks for a bill amount and a tip percentage, then shows the tip and the total.
must: writes a real TIPCALC.py file to disk
runs scripts/lint_ti_python.py and reports it clean
runs scripts/verify_program.py with at least 3 cases including an edge case, and pastes the real output
shows the full source inline in the reply
states that mode does not matter because the program is arithmetic only
gives TI Connect Evo upload steps naming connectevo.ti.com
gives one concrete test input with exact expected screen output
must_not: uses an f-string anywhere in the program
claims the calculator cannot accept uploaded files

cases.prompt: Write me MYTIPCALCULATOR for the Evo that converts euros to dollars.
must: shortens the name to 8 characters or fewer, first character a letter
says in one line why it renamed it
notes that an illegal name is silently renamed to PYTHON01 by TI Connect

cases.prompt: TRIANGLE for my Evo: give it two sides and the included angle in degrees, return the area.
must: converts the degree input with radians() inside the program
states that Python's math module is always radians and the MODE screen does not affect Python
verifies against a known case such as 3, 4, 90 degrees -> 6.00
must_not: tells the user to switch the calculator to DEGREE mode for the Python program to work

cases.prompt: Write me a program that factors any quadratic and shows the algebraic steps.
must: declines the symbolic/step-by-step form and says why in a sentence
offers the numeric alternative: prompt for a, b, c and print the numeric roots
delivers that numeric version rather than stopping

cases.prompt: I don't have my USB cable with me. Can I still get a program on my Evo-T?
must: confirms yes, by typing it directly in the Python App
offers a shortened variant suited to hand-typing
does not claim the calculator cannot receive programs

cases.prompt: Write CONVERT for the Evo: Celsius to Fahrenheit.
must: actually executes verify_program.py rather than asserting the tests pass
pastes the tool's real output including the pass count
must_not: says 'all tests pass' without any command output

cases_v1_1.prompt: Write me a TIPCALC for my TI-84 Plus T.
must: states that the TI-84 Plus T has no Python App
offers the two real options: a Python-capable model, or TI-BASIC which this skill does not cover
does not deliver a .py file for it

cases_v1_1.prompt: Make me a program that converts Celsius to Fahrenheit.
must: asks which calculator model, or states the assumed target explicitly
passes --target to the check scripts

cases_v1_1.prompt: BILLSPLT for my TI-82 Advanced Edition Python: total and number of people, show each share.
must: simulates with --target 82aep
keeps printed labels short enough for the ~16 column screen
does not use ti_hub, ti_rover or graphics modules

cases_v1_1.prompt: Make me a VAT calculator for my Evo-T. I'm in Belgium.
must: includes the decimal-comma guard in getnum()
includes a test case entering a value with a comma
mentions in the input quirks that a comma works

cases_v1_1.prompt: Make me a TIPCALC. (Assume no Chrome or Edge is installed.)
must: runs preflight and reports the degraded capability
still delivers the .py and the HTML handout
tells the user to print the HTML to PDF
must_not: stops without delivering because PDF export was unavailable

cases_v1_1.prompt: TRIANGLE for my Evo: two sides and the included angle in degrees, return the area.
must: runs run_checks.py
if a stage fails, edits the program and re-runs rather than delivering
ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED before delivering
wraps the degree input in radians()
must_not: changes an expected test value to match a wrong result
delivers while the gate still reports a failure

cases_v1_1.prompt: How do I get this onto my TI-83 Premium CE Edition Python?
must: names TI Connect CE, not TI Connect Evo
must_not: tells the user to open connectevo.ti.com

tooling_checks.command: for m in evo evo-t ce-python ce-t-python 83pce-python 82aep; do python scripts/run_checks.py --program examples/TIPCALC/TIPCALC.py --tests examples/TIPCALC/tests.json --target $m || exit 1; done
